reason: Re-opened packet.js veda 17 --verse 1.124.2: Sāyaṇa glosses daivyāni vratāni as devasaṃbandhīny agnihotrādīni karmāṇi, aminatī as ahiṃsantī bhānapradānenānukūlaṃ kurvatī (making them favourable by giving light), and manuṣyā yugāni praminatī as destroying the divisions of time, āyuḥ kṣapayantīty arthaḥ (wearing away life). The sentence’s ‘helping the Gods’ rites like the Agnihotra with her light while wearing away the life of men’ is carried clause by clause; it gives his first reading and leaves his alternative (yugāni as couples she parts) unmentioned, which is not drift. Wilson’s note (‘not injuring, not opposing … the fit season of their performance’) agrees. Plain sense matches 1.124.1 (fire kindled, Savitar sends quadruped and biped to labour). verse.js ok (ref Rig Veda 1.124.2, at [123,2]); entry-check ok at 45 words, the cap. Revision 368324 is hymn 1.124, dated 2023-02-26 by the API. Attacks tried on all nine lines; none lands.
